label: Mercado Bitcoin (public market data)
terms_note: API terms: https://www.mercadobitcoin.com.br/termo-de-uso-apis. Rate limit 500 requests/min in total; /symbols, /tickers and /candles are 1 request/sec each (spec).

list_markets.note: GET /symbols returns every instrument as parallel arrays; the server filters them by `query` (substring of symbol, base or quote, case-insensitive; the API itself filters only by exact symbols), sorts them by symbol and pages them locally (page/limit).

get_ticker.note: symbol is BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-BRL. Prices are in the quote currency; volume is 24h base volume. An unknown symbol answers an empty list (invalid_input).

get_candles.note: interval is one of 1m, 15m, 1h, 3h, 1d, 1w, 1M; the latest `limit` bars up to now (countback). time is the bar's Unix timestamp (seconds, UTC).

not_offered.me: Account endpoints (GET /accounts) need a bearer token from POST /oauth2/token with an API key; this entry serves the keyless public data only.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /accounts/{accountId}/balances needs the Bearer token (securityDefinitions.Bearer); public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /accounts/{accountId}/orders needs the Bearer token; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /accounts/{accountId}/{symbol}/orders needs the Bearer token and spends money; not mapped in this public-data entry.
not_offered.cancel_order: DELETE /accounts/{accountId}/{symbol}/orders/{orderId} needs the Bearer token; not mapped in this public-data entry.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
